decision.justification: Selected 'trimmed_mean on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9853. Series context: trend strength 0.7963 and seasonal strength 0.1266; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.177); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.388.
